metadata.title: Empty tables, tested boundaries: a reproducible audit of one Breakthrough Listen radio cadence
metadata.description:
A reproducible audit of six public 1380-1381 MHz Green Bank Telescope archive scans. The report explains four empty detector tables, demonstrates and corrects a turboSETI 2.3.2 drift-coverage gap, and measures injected-control losses caused by local-maximum selection. Includes exact input identifiers and hashes, code, compact diagnostic results, protocols and reproduction instructions.

One cadence, no new observing exposure, no discovery or survey-completeness claim. Independent processing by Theoxenia; no affiliation, upstream acceptance or external peer review is claimed. Analysis and drafting assisted by OpenAI Codex. Authored report and diagnostics: CC BY 4.0; project code: Apache-2.0; source observations and third-party components retain their original terms. No raw telescope data is redistributed.
